pinyin: bā yuè shí wǔ yún zhē yuè
variants: 八月十五云遮月，正月十五雪打灯
literal: eighth · month · fifteenth · clouds · cover · moon
natural: clouds hide the moon on the fifteenth of the eighth month

meaning.en: If the Mid-Autumn night is cloudy and the moon cannot be seen, folk belief says it will snow or be gloomy around the Lantern Festival.
meaning.zh: 如果中秋夜有云遮住月亮，民间认为到元宵节前后会下雪或阴天。

equivalents: a cloudy Mid-Autumn means a snowy Lantern Festival
folk weather lore for the moon festivals

examples.zh: 八月十五云遮月，看来元宵节要下雪了。
examples.en: Clouds cover the moon at Mid-Autumn, so it looks as though it will snow at the Lantern Festival.

examples.zh: 奶奶说八月十五云遮月，正月十五雪打灯。
examples.en: Grandma says that when clouds cover the moon at Mid-Autumn, snow will fall on the lanterns at the Lantern Festival.

usage.en: Usually the first half of the pair 八月十五云遮月，正月十五雪打灯. It is a folk weather rule that links two festival dates (15th of the 8th and 1st month) and is not scientifically reliable. Not all regions say it.
usage.zh: 通常是“八月十五云遮月，正月十五雪打灯”的上句，把两个节日（八月十五和正月十五）的天气联系起来，属民间经验，并不可靠，也不是各地都这样说。

pinyin: liù yuè tiān, hái ér liǎn
variants: 六月天孩儿脸，说变就变
natural: June weather is like a child's face

meaning.en: Summer weather changes as fast as a child's mood, bright one moment and rainy the next.
meaning.zh: 夏天的天气像小孩的脸一样说变就变，一会儿晴一会儿雨。

equivalents: as changeable as a child's mood

examples.zh: 六月天，孩儿脸，出门最好带把伞。
examples.en: June weather is like a child's face, so it's best to take an umbrella out with you.

examples.zh: 六月天，孩儿脸，刚才还晴着，转眼就下起大雨。
examples.en: June weather is like a child's face: it was sunny a moment ago and now it's pouring.

usage.en: Mostly said of the changeable weather of the lunar sixth month (July or August), but also used figuratively of a person whose moods change quickly. The full line is 六月天孩儿脸，说变就变.
usage.zh: 多指农历六月（约公历七八月）多变的天气，也比喻人情绪变化无常。完整说法是“六月天，孩儿脸，说变就变”。

pinyin: chūn yǔ jīng chūn qīng gǔ tiān
literal: spring · rain · Awakening · Spring Equinox · Clear Bright · Grain Rain · sky
natural: a rhyme listing the spring solar terms

meaning.en: A memory rhyme for the six spring solar terms: Start of Spring, Rain Water, Awakening of Insects, Spring Equinox, Clear and Bright, and Grain Rain.
meaning.zh: 记住春季六个节气的口诀：立春、雨水、惊蛰、春分、清明、谷雨。

equivalents: a mnemonic for the solar terms

examples.zh: 春雨惊春清谷天，夏满芒夏暑相连。
examples.en: The rhyme runs 'Spring Rain, Awakening, Spring Equinox, Clear Bright, Grain Rain', and goes on to summer.

examples.zh: 老师教我们背“春雨惊春清谷天”，这样就记得二十四节气了。
examples.en: The teacher taught us to recite 'chūn yǔ jīng chūn qīng gǔ tiān', so we remember the 24 solar terms.

usage.en: The first line of the 二十四节气歌: 春雨惊春清谷天，夏满芒夏暑相连，秋处露秋寒霜降，冬雪雪冬小大寒. Each character stands for one term, so 惊 = 惊蛰, 春 = 春分, 清 = 清明, 谷 = 谷雨, and so on. Taught in primary school.
usage.zh: 《二十四节气歌》首句：春雨惊春清谷天，夏满芒夏暑相连，秋处露秋寒霜降，冬雪雪冬小大寒。每个字代表一个节气，如“惊”为惊蛰，“春”为春分，“清”为清明，“谷”为谷雨。小学阶段学习。

text: 水是庄稼血，肥是庄稼粮
pinyin: shuǐ shì zhuāng jià xuè, féi shì zhuāng jià liáng
literal: water · is · crops · blood, fertiliser · is · crops · food
natural: water is the blood of the crops, manure is their food

meaning.en: Crops depend on water as the body depends on blood, and on fertiliser as it depends on food.
meaning.zh: 庄稼离不开水和肥，如同人离不开血液和粮食。

equivalents: crops live on water and manure
water and fertiliser are a crop's lifeblood

examples.zh: 水是庄稼血，肥是庄稼粮，老农每年都要浇水施肥。
examples.en: Water is the crops' blood and manure their food, so the old farmer waters and fertilises every year.

examples.zh: 爷爷教我水是庄稼血，肥是庄稼粮，种菜千万别偷懒。
examples.en: Grandpa taught me that water and fertiliser are the crops' lifeblood and said never to skimp when growing vegetables.

usage.en: A farm saying about irrigation and fertiliser. The same idea appears in sayings such as 庄稼一枝花，全靠肥当家.
usage.zh: 关于灌溉施肥的农谚，类似的说法如“庄稼一枝花，全靠肥当家”。

synonyms: 庄稼一枝花，全靠肥当家

text: 不违农时，谷不可胜食也
pinyin: bù wéi nóng shí, gǔ bù kě shèng shí yě
literal: not · violate · farming · season, grain · cannot · exhaust · eating · (particle)
natural: if the farming seasons are not disrupted, there will be more grain than can be eaten

meaning.en: If farm work is never disrupted at the proper season, there will be more grain than people can eat.
meaning.zh: 如果不耽误农业生产的季节，粮食就会吃不完。

equivalents: follow the seasons and the harvest will be plentiful

examples.zh: “不违农时，谷不可胜食也”，政府要保障农民按时耕种。
examples.en: '不违农时，谷不可胜食也': the government must make sure farmers can sow on time.

examples.zh: 爷爷把“不违农时，谷不可胜食也”当作种地的第一条规矩。
examples.en: Grandpa takes '不违农时，谷不可胜食也' as the first rule of farming.

story.en: Mencius tells King Hui of Liang: 'If you do not disrupt the farming seasons, there will be more grain than can be eaten; if fine nets are kept out of the ponds, there will be more fish than can be eaten.' He advises that the people's livelihood is the basis of good government.
story.zh: 《孟子·梁惠王上》：“不违农时，谷不可胜食也；数罟不入洿池，鱼鳖不可胜食也。”孟子向梁惠王说明民生是王道之始。

usage.en: Used about good farming practice and, more broadly, about acting at the right moment; 胜 reads shèng ('all of'). Often shortened to 不违农时.
usage.zh: 既指农业生产要顺应时节，也泛指做事要抓住时机；“胜”读 shèng，意为“尽”。常简作“不违农时”。

pinyin: gǔ yǔ qián hòu, zhòng guā diǎn dòu
literal: Grain Rain · before · after, plant · melons · sow · beans
natural: around Grain Rain, plant melons and sow beans

meaning.en: Around the Grain Rain solar term (about 20 April) the soil is warm and moist enough to plant melons and beans.
meaning.zh: 谷雨（约4月20日）前后，土壤温暖湿润，正是播种瓜和豆的时候。

equivalents: the time to plant melons and beans
sow when the soil is warm

examples.zh: 谷雨前后，种瓜点豆，农民们已经开始播种了。
examples.en: Around Grain Rain you plant melons and sow beans, and the farmers have already begun sowing.

examples.zh: 爷爷说谷雨前后，种瓜点豆，让我们把豆子种下。
examples.en: Grandpa said that around Grain Rain is the time to plant melons and beans and told us to put the beans in.

usage.en: A north China farming saying. 点 here means 'to dibble seeds into the ground'. Timings differ by region.
usage.zh: 北方农谚。“点”指点播种子。各地时间有差异。

pinyin: qīng míng jìn zhǒng, gǔ yǔ chā yāng
literal: Qingming · soak · seeds, Guyu · transplant · seedlings
natural: soak the seeds at Qingming, transplant the seedlings at Guyu

meaning.en: In rice-growing regions the seed rice is soaked around Qingming (about 5 April) and seedlings are transplanted around Guyu (about 20 April).
meaning.zh: 在水稻产区，清明（约4月5日）前后浸泡稻种，谷雨（约4月20日）前后插秧。

equivalents: soak the seed at Qingming, plant out at Guyu

examples.zh: 清明浸种，谷雨插秧，南方的农民开始忙起来了。
examples.en: Seeds are soaked at Qingming and seedlings transplanted at Guyu, and farmers in the south are getting busy.

examples.zh: 按照清明浸种，谷雨插秧的老规矩，他提前准备好了秧田。
examples.en: Following the old rule of soaking seed at Qingming and transplanting at Guyu, he prepared the seedbed ahead of time.

usage.en: A southern rice-farming saying (it differs by locality; early and late rice follow different dates). The lines are often found in the longer rhyme 清明谷雨紧相连，浸种插秧莫迟延.
usage.zh: 南方水稻区的农谚，各地不同，早稻晚稻时间也有差异。常见于“清明谷雨紧相连，浸种插秧莫迟延”。

meaning.en: A courteous request to be looked after, said when meeting someone for the first time or joining a new group.
meaning.zh: 初次见面或加入新团体时，请对方多多照顾的客套话。

equivalents: I look forward to working with you

examples.zh: 我是新来的小王，请多关照。
examples.en: I'm Xiao Wang, the newcomer; please look after me.

examples.zh: 以后在工作上还请多关照。
examples.en: I hope you will help me out in my work from now on.

usage.en: 谦辞 (humble expression): the speaker asks for help. Used at introductions and at the start of a new job or class; also written as 请多多关照. Equivalent to Japanese yoroshiku. Neutral register, polite.
usage.zh: 谦辞：说话人请求对方帮助。用于初次见面、新工作或新班级，也说“请多多关照”。语气礼貌，中性。

meaning.en: A polite phrase asking someone to give guidance or feedback, used at introductions or when presenting one's work.
meaning.zh: 客气地请对方给予指导或意见，用于初次见面或展示作品时。

equivalents: I look forward to your guidance

examples.zh: 我刚入行，请多指教。
examples.en: I'm new to the trade; please give me your guidance.

examples.zh: 这是我的第一部作品，请多指教。
examples.en: This is my first work; please give me your feedback.

usage.en: 谦辞 (humble): the speaker is asking an expert or senior person. 请多指教 is a little more formal than 请多关照 and suggests advice or criticism. Often also 请多多指教.
usage.zh: 谦辞：向前辈或内行请教。比“请多关照”更正式，侧重指点和批评，也说“请多多指教”。

natural: we respectfully ask for your comments

meaning.en: A formal, written request that readers or experts offer corrections and advice.
meaning.zh: 正式的书面用语，恳请读者或专家提出批评和意见。

examples.zh: 论文难免有疏漏之处，敬请指教。
examples.en: The paper may have omissions and we respectfully ask for your corrections.

examples.zh: 本方案初稿完成，敬请指教。
examples.en: The first draft of this proposal is done, and we respectfully request your comments.

usage.en: 谦辞 (humble) used in writing: at the end of a paper, report or letter, or on a presentation slide. More formal than 请多指教, which is also spoken. Pairs of near-synonyms 敬请指教 and 恳请指正 both mean 'please correct us'.
usage.zh: 书面谦辞：用于论文、报告、信函结尾或演示文稿。比口语化的“请多指教”更正式，与“恳请指正”意思相近。

meaning.en: A respectful phrase used by the host to say they are waiting for the guest to attend.
meaning.zh: 主人用来恭敬地表示等候客人前来。

equivalents: we look forward to welcoming you

examples.zh: 婚礼将于周六举行，恭候光临。
examples.en: The wedding will be held on Saturday, and we look forward to welcoming you.

examples.zh: 新店开业，恭候光临。
examples.en: Our new shop is opening: we look forward to your visit.

usage.en: 敬辞 (honorific): about the other person's visit. Used on invitations, shop signs and in letters; it is more formal than 欢迎光临 and implies waiting in advance. 光临 is a standard honorific for 'to come'.
usage.zh: 敬辞：指对方的到来。用于请柬、店铺招牌和书信，比“欢迎光临”更正式，含提前等候之意。“光临”是对“来”的敬称。

natural: you are respectfully invited to attend

meaning.en: A formal invitation phrase asking someone to honour an event with their presence.
meaning.zh: 正式的邀请用语，恭请对方出席。

equivalents: we respectfully invite you to attend

examples.zh: 特此邀请，敬请光临。
examples.en: We hereby invite you and respectfully ask you to attend.

examples.zh: 展览于下周一开幕，敬请光临。
examples.en: The exhibition opens next Monday and you are cordially invited.

usage.en: 敬辞 (honorific): the standard closing on a written invitation. 恭请光临 is the same expression with a slightly more courtly 恭; 敬请 is the more common wording today.
usage.zh: 敬辞：书面请柬的惯用结语。“恭请光临”是同一说法，“恭”字更显古雅，现在更常用“敬请”。

meaning.en: A modest way for a speaker to refer to their own home.

examples.zh: 欢迎各位到寒舍做客。
examples.en: You are all welcome to visit my humble abode.

examples.zh: 寒舍简陋，招待不周，还请见谅。
examples.en: Our home is modest and we have not looked after you well; please forgive us.

usage.en: 谦辞 (humble): only about one's own home, never someone else's (for theirs say 府上 or 贵府). 舍 means 'house'. Formal, slightly old-fashioned, often used jokingly.
usage.zh: 谦辞：只用于自己的家，说对方的家要用“府上”“贵府”。书面色彩，略显旧式，今天也常戏用。

meaning.en: An old-fashioned humble term for one's own wife, used when speaking to others.
meaning.zh: 对别人称呼自己妻子的旧式谦辞。

examples.zh: 这是拙荆，不善言辞，请多包涵。
examples.en: This is my wife, who is not a good speaker, so please bear with her.

examples.zh: 拙荆在家备了薄酒，请您赏光。
examples.en: My wife has prepared a modest meal at home, and I hope you will honour us.

usage.en: 谦辞 (humble): only for one's own wife; for someone else's wife say 尊夫人 or 令正. The term comes from the story of a poor woman who wore a thorn hairpin. It sounds antique and is often used jokingly today; the more neutral 内人 is common.
usage.zh: 谦辞：只用于称自己的妻子；称别人的妻子用“尊夫人”“令正”。相传源于贫妇以荆枝作钗的故事。今天显得古雅，多用于戏谑，较常用的是“内人”。

meaning.en: A modest way for a speaker to refer to their own opinion.

equivalents: if I may offer my modest view

examples.zh: 以上是我的拙见，仅供参考。
examples.en: The above is my humble opinion and offered for reference only.

examples.zh: 依我拙见，这个方案还需修改。
examples.en: In my humble view, this plan still needs revision.

usage.en: 谦辞 (humble): used about one's own views in speeches, essays and letters; the counterpart for someone else's opinion is 高见. Formal; sometimes ironic.
usage.zh: 谦辞：用于演讲、文章和书信中称自己的意见；称对方的意见用“高见”。书面语，有时带反讽。

meaning.en: A very humble, old-fashioned way for a speaker to say 'I'.
meaning.zh: 非常谦卑、旧式的自称，相当于“我”。

examples.zh: 鄙人才疏学浅，请各位多多指教。
examples.en: I, your humble servant, am shallow in talent and learning, so please instruct me.

examples.zh: 这件事鄙人也有责任。
examples.en: I too bear some responsibility for this.

usage.en: 谦辞 (humble) for 'I'. In modern use it is mostly formal speech, literary writing or humour (a self-mocking tone). 鄙 originally means 'rustic', hence 'a rustic person'.
usage.zh: 自称的谦辞。现代多见于正式发言、文学作品或自嘲戏谑。“鄙”本义为乡野之人。

meaning.en: An old-fashioned humble way for a speaker to say 'I', common in historical stories and martial-arts fiction.
meaning.zh: 旧式谦称，相当于“我”，常见于历史故事和武侠小说。

examples.zh: 在下姓李，请多关照。
examples.en: My name is Li, at your service.

examples.zh: 多谢相救，在下感激不尽。
examples.en: Thank you for saving me; I am deeply grateful.

usage.en: 谦辞 (humble) for 'I', literally 'the one below'. In modern Chinese it is mainly seen in costume dramas, novels and joking speech; use 我 in everyday talk. The respectful 'you' it matches is 阁下.
usage.zh: 自称的谦辞，字面意思是“在下位的人”。现代汉语中主要见于古装剧、小说和玩笑话，日常说话用“我”。与之相对的敬称是“阁下”。

natural: thank you for looking after me

meaning.en: A courteous expression of thanks for someone's help and care.
meaning.zh: 对别人的帮助和照顾表示感谢的客气话。

equivalents: thank you for your kind attention
I am grateful for your support

examples.zh: 这几年承蒙关照，我们的小店才能开下去。
examples.en: Thanks to your kind support over the years our shop has been able to stay open.

examples.zh: 承蒙关照，万分感谢。
examples.en: Thank you very much for taking care of me.

usage.en: Courteous thanks: 承蒙 'to be graciously given' marks the other person's kindness (敬辞) and the speaker's gratitude (谦辞). Often used in letters, at the end of a business relationship and on leaving; contrast 请多关照, which looks forward.
usage.zh: 客气的谢语：“承蒙”表示受到对方恩惠，既敬对方，又谦己。多用于信函、业务往来和告别时；与展望未来的“请多关照”相对。
